entries.answer: Aye — dig out three words ye fancy an' cast `/wand`. A wand chooses ye for good. Same three words unlock `/patronus` an' `/broom` after.
Yer `/patronus` is cast from the same three words ye gave `/wand`. No wand yet? Start there first, then come back for the glow.
Yer `/broom` is fit from the same three words as yer wand — a fixed portrait (no customizin'), Speed an' Altitude an' ridiculous stats like Squirrel Spite. All for show. Need a wand first.
Design yer look with `/wizard` — there's Masculine, Feminine, an' Feminine (full body). Show it off anytime with `/mirror`.
`/familiar` adopts one for good — salamander, raven, or fox. Feed, pet, an' play once a day, an' send it `/scout` for a lil' find.

Each place has its own channel. Use `/explore` (up to 10/day per place) an' `/forage` (up to 5/day). Check `/satchel`, try `/use`, leave an `/offer`. `/places` shows where ye can go — places remember how ye treat 'em.

Beasts wander into the explore channel an' say what they want. First to `/approach` with those things befriends 'em. See yer collection with `/bestiary`, show one off with `/summon`. Want notes on one ye already have? That's `/study`.
Got a befriended beast? `/study` it once a day — three pages fills yer notes. Read 'em with `/journal`. Finish all three an' yer house gets **5** points once for that beast.
Nifflers are the shiny-thievin' beasts — one uncommon per place. Spot 'em in `/bestiary`, or brew **Niffler's Bait** if ye want a private encounter with one.

`/duel` is best of three — both pick a spell in secret. Hex, Ward, Disarm, Bind, Mirror; each beats two an' loses to two. There's also `/trio scramble`, `/trio housematch`, an' `/grand` for the big leagues.
When a wild threat crawls into a channel, ye need a patronus ready — then `/cast` to banish it. Check `/help` under Play for the cast command.

The Descent is a hundred-floor solo dungeon. `/descend` fights yer next monster; `/descend floor:n` replays a cleared floor for practice an' loot. `/descentstatus` shows floor, stats, an' lockouts. Three losses on a floor locks ye out 24 hours.

Replay a cleared floor with `/descend floor:n` (not bosses). Practice can sharpen ye with a free stat pick — closer floors more often. Spend any pending stat pick first, or the grind won't award another.
Quidditch runs house matches an' scrambles — five rounds, an' a Snitch that can end it all. Peek `/help` or the Compendium Quidditch page for the commands.
`/raid` opens a 3Raid lobby — Attacker, Specialty, Tank, ten encounters. `/raidstatus` shows yer weekly clear.

`/market browse` is the catalogue. Buy common/uncommon with `/market buy`. Sell place ingredients in sets of 3, or Descent materials in sets of 25, for 3 pts each batch — add `batches:` to sell several at once (21 pts/day cap). Also scrolls, titles, an' the Room.
Brewin' lives with yer ingredients from forage an' the market. Check `/help` for potion commands in yer server — gather bits in yer `/satchel` first.
`/jewelbox` shows what ye own. `/craft` makes pieces from satchel materials; `/wear` an' `/remove` kit ye out. `/title` picks which earned title shows under yer name.
Five houses chase one Cup. Almost everythin' ye do earns points for yer house. `/standings` shows the table; `/points` shows yer own; `/profile` is the full picture.
Challenges post for everyone — first three correct answers win points. Daily is every 24 hours (pings @everyone); Trial an' Rite on their schedule. `/challengestatus` shows what's open.
Chess an' checkers aren't ready yet — the boards are still bein' polished. Pip'll tell ye when ye can challenge a classmate.
`/bean` spends 1 point on a mystery bean. Might pay 5. Might be Mordy's socks. Aye, really.
`/rumor` conjures a whisper from the mill — explore secrets, student gossip, odd headmaster talk, embarrassín' ghosts. Believe nothin'.
The founders never quite left. Their stories live on the Compendium Ghosts page — an' sometimes in a `/rumor` if the mill's feelin' cheeky.
Tap `/help` for everythin' the bot can do, grouped an' clickable. Or browse Every Command on the Compendium if ye want the big map.
`/profile` is yer whole sheet — Mirror, wand, points, ranks, beasts. `/standings` is the Cup table; `/leaderboard` the top earners; `/duelrecord` yer duel sheet.

Aye — cast `/checklist` for yer daily board: explore, beans, duels, beasts, market sell, familiar, an' open challenges, each with how many ye've got left an' when it resets. It's public, but only yer own — nobody else can pull it for ye.
